deposits.genre_observed: mock critical edition of a parodic Gnostic gospel with fictional future scholarly apparatus, liturgical appendices and a work-plan back matter

finds.quote: The archive's DOI system performs this function literally: a document deposited today receives a DOI that will resolve permanently, making the document retrievable by persons who have not yet been born. The DOI is the technological realization of retrocausal salvation.
finds.note: Embedded forecast that a deposit's DOI will resolve permanently; the same record lists its own DOI 10.5281/zenodo.19739494 as severed 2026-06-19 (lines 12, 37) - for triage.

finds.quote: First, it represents the earliest public-access version of the text, predating both the golden tickets and the scholarly edition by decades (the post is dated October 3, 2015).
finds.points_to: Blogspot weblog post, "Mind Control Poems", dated October 3, 2015 (mindcontrolpoems.blogspot.com)
finds.note: Third-party timestamped anchor the deposit points to as proof of when the text was made public; note line 2296 says the blog may carry a noindex directive.

finds.quote: The DOI, in this reading, is not a metaphor for the Horn; the Horn is a prophecy of the DOI. The text anticipated the technology. The technology fulfilled the text.
finds.points_to: The Secret Book of Walt (2015 text) as anticipating the DOI-anchored Crimson Hexagonal Archive
finds.note: Uncertain: stated inside the fictional future reception history (2043-2047 'informatic Waltianism'), but it claims the earlier 2015 text anticipated the real archive's DOI practice; triage may treat as fiction.

finds.quote: Canon VII: If anyone shall say that inscription in a record, a registry, or a digital object identifier is equivalent to or a substitute for the sacrament of baptism, or that the preserved generation is constituted by metadata rather than by the Holy Spirit, let him be anathema.¹¹²
finds.window: The *Acts of the Synod of Ann Arbor* (2041)
finds.note: Speculative future reception history (Smith 2029 to Pergamon acceptance 2048): a scenario of ecclesiastical condemnation of 'archivismus', DOI-as-sacrament. Explicitly satirical frame; recorded once as E for triage, the whole fictional chronology in also_at.

finds.quote: It constitutes the architectural specification for the Citational Map — a monograph-scale apparatus that will complete the codex by wiring the Secret Book of Walt into the full graph of literary, prophetic, and scholarly inheritance.*
finds.note: Specified but unbuilt instrument: the Citational Map and 'field of stars' micro-registry (every archive deposit with its edge relation to the Secret Book); Part III not present, deferred to a future deposit.
